name: mail-watch
description: Gives your Claude Code agent an inbox: it watches a mailbox and wakes the session when trusted, authenticated mail arrives.

account.title: Mailbox address
account.description: The inbox to watch, e.g. agent@example.com. Leave empty to keep the watch off.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: auto: lolabot when the session's folder has tools/email.sh, standalone otherwise. lolabot: only in lolabot folders. standalone: the built-in IMAP watcher.

trustedSenders.title: Trusted senders (standalone)
trustedSenders.description: Comma-separated addresses whose authenticated mail wakes the agent. lolabot uses its own operator_emails instead.

imapHost.title: IMAP server (standalone)
imapHost.description: e.g. imap.purelymail.com or imap.gmail.com. The login is the mailbox address.

passwordEnv.title: Password variable (standalone)
passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable, or the key in the project's .env file, that holds the mailbox password.

pollMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often to look for new mail.

folder.title: Only in this folder
folder.description: Absolute path. When set, the watch runs only in sessions started in this folder, so other sessions don't answer mail too.

instructions.title: Extra instructions
instructions.description: Added to the end of every wake-up prompt, e.g. who may ask for what.

python.title: Python (standalone)
python.description: The Python 3.9+ the built-in watcher runs with.
